title: Implement strategy trade performance attribution and CSV JSON export
acceptance_criteria: metrics.py builds TradeCycleRecord values whose entry/exit prices are fill-quantity-weighted and whose realized P&L is correct for a multi-partial-fill fixture
Exits by protective stop, trailing stop, manual close, flatten, end of day or safety are attributed to that exit cause while the originating BUY strategy is preserved
Aggregations filter by account/scenario, period, symbol, BUY strategy, SELL strategy, pair and exit cause, and every money value is a Decimal
Slippage is reported in Decimal dollars and basis points, and latency is reported as signal-to-submit, submit-to-first-fill and first-to-final-fill durations
A cycle whose fee status is missing or UNAVAILABLE reports fees_complete=false, and its net P&L excludes fabricated fees
The live-vs-shadow comparison reports matched, missed and extra trades for two named accounts/scenarios and never sums their balances
Every report payload includes sample size and a performance_disclaimer field
export.py emits CSV and JSON with schema_version, fixed column order, deterministic sorting, Decimal-as-string values, UTC ISO timestamps and masked account identifiers
Exporting the same input twice yields byte-identical output, and exporting to an existing path without overwrite=True raises an error
tests/unit/test_strategy_reports.py contains passing positive and negative tests and uses no network access or broker credentials
forbidden_changes: import or modify mike_trade/reporting/fees.py or mike_trade/reporting/accounting.py
write to the trading database or mutate any persisted state from reporting code
convert money, quantity or price values to float
claim or label strategy profitability beyond reported historical/simulated figures
aggregate balances across accounts, modes or scenarios
access broker credentials or create broker orders
run broad test suites or backtests
